tools.name: get_wine_stock_index
tools.description: The VINCAP Wine Stock Index (BCWINE): live level, published close, constituents with symbol, country, exchange and weight. Prices are delayed. Example: {}

tools.name: get_wine_company
tools.description: One listed wine company by symbol: latest reported result lines (revenue, operating and net result) with the source URL and locator they were read from, and its next investor event. Example: {"symbol":"TWE.AX"}

tools.name: get_investor_calendar
tools.description: The next results dates, AGMs and dividends of listed wine companies, from issuer and exchange sources. Free: the next 5 rows. The full calendar with recorded outcomes: the paid x402 route in `paid`. Example: {"symbol":"TWE.AX"}

tools.name: get_estates
tools.description: Which estates, wineries and vineyards a listed wine company owns. Free: the count and names. The full monthly record with history and source probes: the paid x402 route in `paid`. Example: {"symbol":"TWE.AX"}

tools.name: rank_wine_companies
tools.description: Every listed wine company VINCAP tracks (index constituents and tracked companies), ranked on the weights you set, 0-5 each: growth (revenue growth, latest period), margin (net margin), y1 (1-year share price), wine (wine share of revenue), from_high (further below the 52-week high scores higher). E

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_wine_company · Private data: get_estates · Public sink: rank_wine_companies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_wine_company · Private data: get_estates · Public sink: rank_wine_companies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
